items.item_text: Driver's License: CA, upon hire and
Masters Of Nursing in Nursing or a related field, upon hire and
2 years experience in Home Health or Hospice
1 year experience with Health Care information system
Supervisory Hospice experience., upon hire and
Ensures that all actions taken and methods used to produce the results outlined in this job description incorporate and promote the Mission and Philosophy of Mercy Home Health & Hospice
Actively participates in the recruitment and hiring, process for all new clinical staff. Acts as a resource for these activities for non-clinical staff.

Supervises all new clinical staff during their orientation period. This responsibility includes making home evaluation visits, documentation oversight, conducting status meetings, scheduling and completing the three-month evaluation.

Communicates with appropriate clinical supervisors regarding staff progress and any human resource or performance counseling issues occurring during the orientation period. Provides corrective action up to and including dismissal during the employees orientation period.
Develops, implements and continually evaluates all orientation and training activities/programs for all staff; including required competency testing and mandatory inservice education.

Functions as the clinical expert for development, education, training and trouble-shooting of the home care-specific automated medical record system. May be on-call. Plans and conducts staff training.
Registered Nurse: CA, upon hire and
Healthcare information systems, in a homehealth setting., upon hire
